name: tsh-product-management
description: The business-analysis workflow end to end: discovery workshop materials — transcripts, Figma, PDFs, codebase context — become Jira-ready epics and user stories, a per-product domain dictionary and an outcome-based delivery roadmap, behind five human review gates, with a hook that blocks any Jira write before the push gate is approved. Also imports an existing Jira backlog for local iteration.
